title: Segment Count Schedule for Spend-Milestone Bonuses under Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements
content:
**Schedule.** For a spend-milestone bonus on a Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements agreement, the segments credited in the current agreement year are counted as the points accrual entries on the agreement dated fewer whole calendar months before the credit date than the milestone pace plus one. The milestone pace is the number of whole calendar months the current agreement year has run at the credit date, counted from the latest anniversary of the approval date. The count adds a segment uplift:

| Segments credited in the current agreement year | Segment uplift |
|---|---|
| 30 or more | 10 percentage points |
| 15 or more, and fewer than 30 | 5 percentage points |
| fewer than 15 | nothing |

**How the uplift acts.** The uplift is counted in percentage points; milestone uplifts on different grounds are added together, and the milestone bonus is raised by the total: the milestone bonus before its allowance is the milestone bonus multiplied by one hundred plus the total uplift, divided by one hundred, rounded down to the whole point.

### Reading the count (hypothetical)

- With a milestone pace of 7 months, the entries counted are the points accrual entries dated fewer than 8 whole calendar months before the credit date.
- Every points accrual entry on the agreement inside that span counts once; spend entries, bonus entries and redemption entries are not counted.

| Count | Segment uplift |
|---|---|
| 14 | nothing |
| 15 | 5 percentage points |
| 29 | 5 percentage points |
| 30 | 10 percentage points |
